import { Component, EventEmitter, Output } from '@angular/core'; @Component({ selector: 'app-navbar', templateUrl: './navbar.component.html', styleUrls: ['./navbar.component.scss'] }) export class NavbarComponent { @Output() search = new EventEmitter(); searchValue = ''; onSearchChange(): void { this.search.emit(this.searchValue); } }
